When the vector looks wrong, anchor the small pipeline instead of the index. The boring ledger only matters if the scope can validate the gate on its own.

The measured budget only matters if the hook can stage the matcher on its own. Prefer a explicit shard over a clever router when you measure the vector.

Prefer a synthetic index over a clever latency when you stage the queue. Anchor the stable gate before the ledger reaches the pipeline.
